item.title: GiveWP Unauthenticated PHP Object Injection via Weak Serialized-Data Regex Check (CVE-2025-22777)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 9.8) — web · CVE-2025-22777. Status: PoC. Affects: GiveWP – Donation Plugin and Fundraising Platform (WordPress plugin, 100,000+ active installs). Tags: givewp, wordpress, wordpress-plugin, php-object-injection, deserialization, unserialize, gadget-chain, cwe-502, php, unauthenticated.

item.title: Everest Forms Unauthenticated PHP Object Injection to RCE (CVE-2026-3296)
